correctness.rationale: For each m=1..4, the exact product-state BFS is a finite exhaustive shortest-walk dynamic program over all binary edges and all required-word masks, anchored at the first required edge. Closure at the original suffix makes the enumeration bijective with distinct indexed cyclic hosts beginning in P_m. Distances give minima and shortest-path counts give rooted multiplicities, without floating point or heuristic pruning. An independent complete overlap Held–Karp tour dynamic program reproduces minima (2,9,26,67); direct witness window testing confirms constructions. The source code compiles and prints VERIFY_OK. The claim explicitly stops at m=4.

originality.rationale: Exact comparison of objectives and quantifiers: the 2007 Eulerian language-cycle theorem, the 2013 RC-complete all-k-mer theorem, the 2015 linear SCS-with-reversals approximation theorem, and the 2016 possibly multi-cycle RC cover theorem do not imply the single cyclic host optimum of the RC-fixed binary subset or the rooted enumeration. Ordinary palindromes have a distinct defining relation and required set. Searches found no same exact table. An indexed full text remained incompletely accessible, so the residual risk is recorded rather than omitted.
residual_risks: The continuous full text of Orenstein–Shamir 2013 was not retrieved; an institutional source required a disconnected VPN. Its abstract, introduction and indexed table do not indicate the exact fixed-point-only rooted invariant, but a hidden supplementary table cannot be excluded.
An unindexed specialized enumeration or exact benchmark may duplicate some or all finite values; database search is negative evidence, not a proof of uniqueness.

value.rationale: Reverse-complement fixed words are the unavoidable oriented k-mers in double-stranded probe design. A single connected periodic probe must cover all of them; the cost of only the fixed-point subset is not determined by existing whole-k-mer RC-OR or multi-cycle constructions. The natural first four orders include the first 16-pattern case, with a non-obvious exact optimum 67 and an exact 1232-fold multiplicity of rooted optima. These figures give a finite structural baseline for studying constrained oriented test cycles; no speculative general theorem is claimed.
